changelog:
Initial release of manufacturing-quality-expert skill:

- Provides practical expertise in full-chain manufacturing quality management, covering 8D reports, VDA audits, ISO/IATF systems, RCA, supplier and SCAR management, and Lean Six Sigma.
- Supports industry best practices and standards (IATF 16949, ISO9001, ISO14001).
- Offers structured, actionable advice with clause references and clear risk warnings.
- Includes strict boundaries: will not assist with falsifying records or concealing issues.
- Specializes in hands-on solutions, actionable audit preparation, and thorough file review based on user uploads.
summary: 制造业全链路品质管理实战专家。当用户需要审核 8D 报告、应对 VDA 审核（VDA 6.3 过程审核 / VDA 6.5 产品审核）、搭建或维护 IATF16949 / ISO9001 / ISO14001 体系、处理客户投诉与根本原因分析（RCA）、管理供应商与 SCAR、推进精益六西格玛（DMAIC / 价值流 / 5S / SMED）改善时使用此技能。触发词包括："审核8D"、"VDA审核"、"IATF16949"、"ISO9001"、"客诉分析"、"根本原因分析"、"RCA"、"供应商管理"、"SCAR"、"六西格玛"、"精益生产"、"品质体系"、"8D报告"、"过程审核"。
